readme:
# Arbeit.swiss / Travail.swiss / Lavoro.swiss / Work.swiss Job Scraper

Scrapes job listings from the **SECO Job-Room.ch** federal employment platform, Switzerland's official multilingual government job portal operated by RAV/SECO (Staatssekretariat fur Wirtschaft / Secretariat d'Etat a l'economie / Segreteria di Stato dell'economia). The same platform is served under four language-branded domains:

- [arbeit.swiss](https://www.arbeit.swiss) (German / Deutsch)
- [travail.swiss](https://www.travail.swiss) (French / Francais)
- [lavoro.swiss](https://www.lavoro.swiss) (Italian / Italiano)
- [work.swiss](https://www.work.swiss) (English)

All four surfaces expose the same underlying Job-Room API, so this single actor covers every canton and every Swiss national language. DE-, FR-, IT-, and EN-speaking users all get the same normalized `JobListing` output.

## Features

- **Multi-query support** - Run multiple search keywords in a single actor run, deduplicated across queries
- **Per-query limits** - Control how many results each keyword returns independently
- **API-based scraping** - Uses the official Job-Room API for fast, reliable data extraction
- **Three scraping modes** - Search mode or direct URL mode for different use cases
- **Job status detection** - Track if jobs are still online, offline, or expired (direct URL mode)
- **Comprehensive job data** - Extracts title, company, location, workload, contact details, and more
- **Canton filtering** - Filter jobs by Swiss canton codes
- **Sort order** - Sort by date (newest/oldest first) or default
- **Standardized output** - Returns data in the `JobListing` schema format with `search_query` tracking
- **Proxy support** - Optional proxy configuration for different network setups

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/arbeit-swiss-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `arbeit-swiss-scraper` to scrape job listings from the Swiss federal Job-Room platform (arbeit.swiss / travail.swiss / lavoro.swiss / work.swiss). Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `directUrls` | string[] | Direct job URLs to scrape (skips search mode) | `[]` |
| `searchQueries` | string[] | One or more search keywords. Each runs as a separate search, deduplicated. | `[]` |
| `keywords` | string[] | Legacy: search keywords (use `searchQueries` instead) | `[]` |
| `cantonCodes` | string[] | Swiss canton codes (e.g., `["ZH", "BE", "SG"]`) | `[]` (all cantons) |
| `sortBy` | string | Sort order: `date_desc`, `date_asc`, or empty for default | `""` |
| `workloadMin` | integer | Minimum workload percentage (Pensum) | `10` |
| `workloadMax` | integer | Maximum workload percentage (Pensum) | `100` |
| `onlineSinceDays` | integer | Only include jobs posted within this many days | `60` |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Max results per search keyword | `100` |
| `maxResults` | integer | Total cap across all queries. 0 = unlimited. | `0` |
| `statsMode` | string | Per-query statistics output: `off`, `include`, `only` | `off` |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Apify proxy settings | Residential CH |

### Statistics output (optional)

Set `statsMode` to get per-query statistics alongside or instead of job data — useful for workflow control (resume state, "was it worth a full scrape?") and cheap labour-market snapshots.

| Mode | Dataset output | Cost |
|------|---------------|------|
| `off` (default) | Jobs only, no stats items — unchanged behaviour | Standard per-result pricing |
| `include` | Jobs + one `type: "stats"` item per query + one `type: "run_summary"` | Standard per-result pricing (stats items are free) |
| `only` | Stats + run_summary only, no jobs, no detail fetches | One page fetch per query, no per-result charges |

Each stats item carries the platform-reported total (from arbeit.swiss's `X-Total-Count` header — same value the job-room.ch UI shows), page count, how far the scrape got, why it stopped, and — if it stopped early — the exact URL/page/offset to resume from. A `STATS` record is always written to the key-value store so workflows can read resume state without parsing a mixed dataset.

Field-level contract (schema version, `stopReason` enum, resume shape) is stable across `type: "stats"` items — see `docs/JOBSTATS_SPEC.md` in the source repo.

### Example: Multi-Query Search

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["Pflege", "IT", "Buchhaltung"],
  "cantonCodes": ["ZH", "BE"],
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 50,
  "sortBy": "date_desc"
}
```

### Example: Single Search

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["Software Engineer"],
  "cantonCodes": ["ZH"],
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 200
}
```

### Example: Direct URLs (Still Alive Checks)

```json
{
  "directUrls": [
    "https://www.job-room.ch/job-search/abc123-def456",
    "https://www.job-room.ch/job-search/xyz789-uvw012"
  ]
}
```

## Output

Each job listing follows the standardized `JobListing` schema:

```json
{
  "id": "abc123-def456",
  "title": "Dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/FH",
  "company": "Universitatsspital Zurich",
  "location": "Zurich, ZH",
  "canton": "ZH",
  "job_status": null,
  "employment_type": "full-time",
  "workload_min": 80,
  "workload_max": 100,
  "remote_option": null,
  "description_snippet": "Wir suchen eine engagierte Pflegefachperson...",
  "description_full": "...",
  "requirements": [],
  "posted_at": "2024-01-15T00:00:00.000Z",
  "expires_at": "2024-02-15T00:00:00.000Z",
  "source_url": "https://www.job-room.ch/job-search/abc123-def456",
  "source_platform": "arbeit.swiss",
  "contact_salutation": "Frau",
  "contact_firstname": "Maria",
  "contact_lastname": "Mueller",
  "contact_email": "jobs@usz.ch",
  "contact_phone": "+41442551111",
  "apply_url": "https://careers.usz.ch/apply/123",
  "apply_email": "bewerbung@usz.ch",
  "company_url": "https://www.usz.ch",
  "search_query": "Pflege",
  "scraped_at": "2024-01-16T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### Field Notes

- **`search_query`** - The search keyword that found this job (null for direct URL mode)
- **`job_status`** - Only populated in Direct URL mode; null in search mode
- **Salary fields** - Not available in arbeit.swiss API; always null
- **`requirements`** - Not easily extractable from API; empty array

## Important: Network Requirements

The arbeit.swiss API (job-room.ch) has strict access controls:

- Works: Residential IPs, corporate networks, VPNs with residential exit
- Blocked: Cloud/datacenter IPs (including Apify infrastructure)

Recommended: Use residential proxy (configured by default).

## Performance

- **Speed**: ~250 jobs/minute (limited by respectful rate limiting)
- **Cost**: ~0.01-0.05 CU per 1,000 jobs
- **Reliability**: Built-in retry logic with exponential backoff

## Data Source

- **Websites** (same platform, four language surfaces): [arbeit.swiss](https://www.arbeit.swiss) (DE) · [travail.swiss](https://www.travail.swiss) (FR) · [lavoro.swiss](https://www.lavoro.swiss) (IT) · [work.swiss](https://www.work.swiss) (EN)
- **Underlying platform**: Job-Room.ch
- **Search API**: `POST https://www.job-room.ch/jobadservice/api/jobAdvertisements/_search`
- **Operator**: SECO (Staatssekretariat fur Wirtschaft / Secretariat d'Etat a l'economie / Segreteria di Stato dell'economia)

## Legal Notice

This actor accesses publicly available job listings through the official API. Please ensure your use case complies with the SECO Job-Room terms of service, available in [DE](https://www.arbeit.swiss/secoalv/de/home/menue/nutzungsbedingungen.html), [FR](https://www.travail.swiss/secoalv/fr/home/menue/nutzungsbedingungen.html), [IT](https://www.lavoro.swiss/secoalv/it/home/menue/nutzungsbedingungen.html), and [EN](https://www.work.swiss/secoalv/en/home/menue/nutzungsbedingungen.html).
